CustomField.description: Per AC-9/AC-10, identifies which kind of renewal loss Loss_MRR__c reflects: the renewal closed Won but at a reduced MRR (Partial), or the renewal never happened at all (Full). Set by FinancialMetricsService alongside Loss_MRR__c itself, not by a separate process, so the two fields can never disagree.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Which kind of renewal loss this is. Renewal - Partial: the renewal still closed Won, just at a lower MRR. Renewal - Full: the Opportunity closed Lost and the renewal never happened.
CustomField.label: Loss Type
